coordinate: At 09:46 on trade day t, use SOXX's split-continuous Qlib close on the original Stage1 signal date t-1. Risk-on iff that close is strictly above the trailing 200 actual Qlib sessions' mean including that already completed signal date. Require the full warmup. scope: All original 944 funded Stage1 0bp Tiered trade dates, 2023/2026 partial and 2024/2025 full years, all 16 quarters and all 819 contiguous 126-session windows. Retain every risk-on/off and positive/negative cash component row; compare 2024Q3 protection and 2025 cash drag as prior motivating intervals.
decision_boundary: This is source-and-receiver alignment only. A MA200 risk-on override that misses most 2025 cash loss and falls on effective 2024 cash protection is not advanced to a full account. It cannot prove all trend rules fail, and prior standalone MA200 family remains closed. No MA length, sign, ETF, cash threshold or interval rescue.
